verdict.detail: The album first came out in 2019.

notes.text:
Made in Germany

13 Disc / 127 track box set celebrating Gong's Virgin years containing 53 previously unreleased tracks.
Curated by
Remastered from the original Virgin Masters by original producer

The 64 page book contains Gong's musings, band thoughts, both unseen and well loved photographs and artwork, and more.
Also features the legendary Blue Book and new Green Book containing lyrics and Daevid Allen drawings.

CD5-1 to CD5-4 BBC Radio session 29 May 1973
CD5-5 to CD5-11 BBC Radio session 15 January 1975
CD5-12 & CD5-13 Live at the Edinburgh Festival 1973
CD-10 London - Hyde Park Live, 28th June 1974
actually took place on Saturday 29th June 1974.
